How many orders are there?.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders

What were total sales in Vancouver?.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.amount_cad), 2) AS sales_cad FROM orders o JOIN stores s USING (store_id) WHERE s.city = 'Vancouver'

Which category sold the most items?.sql: SELECT category, SUM(quantity) AS items FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY items DESC LIMIT 1

How much did I spend in total?.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_cad), 2) AS spent_cad FROM orders WHERE customer_id = '{customer_id}'
